_comment: Pretrained weights used by KiraPick. Files live in models/weights/ (git-ignored) and are fetched once at development/packaging time with scripts/fetch_models.py; the app never downloads at runtime and refuses files whose SHA-256 differs.

models.name: YuNet face detector (2023mar)
models.provenance: opencv/opencv_zoo@48b10fa models/face_detection_yunet (LICENSE: MIT, Shiqi Yu). Trained with libfacedetection.train; best for faces ~10-300 px.

models.name: SFace face recognition (2021dec, MobileFaceNet)
models.provenance: opencv/opencv_zoo@48b10fa models/face_recognition_sface (LICENSE: Apache-2.0). 128-d embedding of a 112x112 aligned face.

models.name: ArcFace face recognition (InsightFace buffalo_l, ResNet50 WebFace600K)
models.provenance: deepinsight/insightface release v0.7, buffalo_l.zip member w600k_r50.onnx (code MIT; the pretrained models 'are available for non-commercial research purposes only'). 512-d embedding of a 112x112 face aligned to the ArcFace 5-point template, RGB (x-127.5)/127.5. Owner approved its use in this non-commercial app with a disclaimer (2026-10-27). On the owner's labelled shoot (thumbnails) pair AUC 0.959 vs 0.945 for SFace at full resolution.

models.name: YoutuReID person re-identification (2021nov)
models.provenance: opencv/opencv_zoo@48b10fa models/person_reid_youtureid (LICENSE: Apache-2.0, Tencent Youtu Lab). Whole-body appearance embedding of a person crop resized to 128x256, RGB, ImageNet mean/std. Trained on street pedestrians, not cosplay: used only together with time and face cues.

models.name: YOLOX-S (COCO, person class used)
models.provenance: Megvii-BaseDetection/YOLOX release 0.1.1rc0 (LICENSE: Apache-2.0). Input 640x640 BGR 0-255, output 8400x85.

models.name: YOLOX-M (COCO, person class used)
models.provenance: Megvii-BaseDetection/YOLOX release 0.1.1rc0 (LICENSE: Apache-2.0). More accurate, used on GPU.

models.name: eDifFIQA(T) face image quality (jun2024)
models.provenance: opencv/opencv_zoo@48b10fa models/face_image_quality_assessment_ediffiqa (LICENSE: CC BY 4.0; Babnik et al., eDifFIQA, IEEE T-BIOM 2024). MobileFaceNet backbone + quality head; input 112x112 face aligned like SFace, RGB normalised to [-1, 1]; higher = better face image (sharpness, pose, occlusion).

models.name: MediaPipe Face Landmarker v2: 478 face landmarks (ONNX)
models.provenance: Converted to ONNX (opset 17) with tf2onnx 1.16.1 from face_landmarker.task v1 float16 (https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task, Apache-2.0, model card 'MediaPipe Face Mesh V2' / 'Blendshape V2'); reproduce with scripts/convert_mediapipe.py; outputs checked against the TFLite interpreter (landmarks max diff 4e-4 px, blendshapes 1e-6).

models.name: MediaPipe face blendshapes v2: 52 expression scores incl. eye blink (ONNX)
models.provenance: Converted to ONNX (opset 17) with tf2onnx 1.16.1 from face_landmarker.task v1 float16 (https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task, Apache-2.0, model card 'MediaPipe Face Mesh V2' / 'Blendshape V2'); reproduce with scripts/convert_mediapipe.py; outputs checked against the TFLite interpreter (landmarks max diff 4e-4 px, blendshapes 1e-6).

models.name: TOPIQ image aesthetics (CFANet, ResNet50, AVA) — ONNX
models.provenance: Converted at build time by scripts/convert_topiq.py from cfanet_iaa_ava_res50-3cd62bb3.pth (IQA-PyTorch GitHub release v0.1-weights, SHA-256 3cd62bb3…6975; Chen et al., TOPIQ, IEEE TIP 2024); trained on AVA. ONNX checked against PyTorch on 4 shapes (< 1e-3). The export is not byte-reproducible, so the converter writes a .sha256 file next to it that the registry checks. Non-commercial weights: approved by the owner for this non-commercial app (2026-10-27).

models.name: OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14 image encoder — ONNX
models.license: MIT (code); OpenAI model card: deployed use out of scope — accepted by the owner (2026-10-28)
models.provenance: Converted at build time by scripts/convert_clip.py from OpenAI ViT-L-14.pt (openaipublic, SHA-256 b8cca3fd…3836, Radford et al. 2021). Image tower + projection, static 1x3x224x224 input; checked against PyTorch (cosine >= 0.999). The converter writes a .sha256 file next to it.

models.name: LAION improved aesthetic predictor (sac+logos+ava1, linear MSE) — ONNX
models.provenance: MLP head from christophschuhmann/improved-aesthetic-predictor (sac+logos+ava1-l14-linearMSE.pth), trained on SAC, LAION-Logos and AVA ratings of CLIP ViT-L/14 embeddings. Converted and checked (|delta| <= 0.01) by scripts/convert_clip.py.

models.name: CLIP text embeddings of KiraPick style prompts
models.license: derived from OpenAI CLIP (same terms as clip_l14_image)
models.provenance: Text embeddings of the fixed English prompts in scripts/convert_clip.py (PROMPTS), computed with the OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14 text tower at build time.
